title: Cold Calling Laws in South Africa: Your AI Agent Gets One Call
meta_description: Read on 5 October 2026: POPIA names automatic calling machines and protects companies too. An AI agent may call a non-customer once, only to ask for consent.
secondary_keywords: popia b2b cold calling juristic persons
can an ai voice agent cold call in south africa
direct marketing calling hours south africa

image.takeaway: POPIA lets an AI agent call a business that is not your customer at most once, only to ask for consent.
image.alt: Cold calling laws in South Africa: under POPIA an AI voice agent may call a non-customer once, only to ask for consent, and companies are protected too
